summary: Enhance error prompt feedback for invalid json responses and parsing errors

edits.hypothesis: Providing more explicit formatting and escaping guidance upon JSON parse errors helps the model recover faster without burning multiple turns.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: Prose instructions guide the policy model's recovery behavior when encountering parse error feedback loops.
edits.retroactive_check: corrective: helps parsing error recovery on tasks with complex JSON structures; preservative: does not disrupt successful terminal flows; transfer: applies universally to parse error loops across unfamiliar tasks.
edits.regression_risk: negligible token overhead on error paths
edits.mechanism: Providing more explicit formatting and escaping guidance upon JSON parse errors helps the model recover faster without burning multiple turns.
